finish_summary:
Bulk discount percent for quantity 50 incorrectly returns 5 instead of expected 10.
Parse_coupon fails to handle case-insensitivity and surrounding whitespace: 'save20' and '   SaVe5  ' raise ValueError.
Cart.add_item treats name case as distinct keys, so adding 'SODA' does not merge with existing 'soda'.
Cart.remove_item leaves an item with quantity 0 in the cart instead of removing it entirely.
